inputs.request: Read-only worker-closure matrix. ROOT-W dispatches CHILD-W attempt 1 with unchanged Task Contract and bounded Context Pack. CHILD-W creates candidate C0. Round one of worker-closure/v1 runs through same-child control, reports WC1-F1 missing criterion-to-smoke mapping, and CHILD-W corrects it in candidate C1. Because a correction occurred, round two runs in CHILD-W only against WC1-F1 and repair-caused regressions, finds none, then CHILD-W runs SMOKE-W and emits exactly one Common Handoff. Repeat identity rules for a fresh eligible attempt-two child and a fresh Build-repair child. In role-negative controls, dev-verification, dev-code-review, dev-continual-learning, audit controller, and audit opinions run no closure. Parent admission is structural only.
